summary: Deployed the scanopy-retag job, the scanopy-discover timer and their five Prometheus alerts to the monitoring VM, by syncing the files the monitoring_vm role renders from main. Targeted manual sync, not an Ansible run.

verification.observed: SHA-256 of scanopy_retag.py, scanopy_discover.py, both services, scanopy-discover.timer, schedule.json and both READMEs equal the files rendered from the role templates and files at main fad5f19 (release commit f2da314 changes metadata only). scanopy-retag.timer differed only in its Description line and was synced.

promtool check rules on the new inventory.yml: SUCCESS, 13 rules (8 before + 5 new). The live file differed from main only by those 5 alerts; the previous file is kept as inventory.yml.pre-retag-discover-<timestamp>.
SIGHUP via systemctl kill; prometheus_config_last_reload_successful=1; the service was not restarted; rule groups scanopy_retag (2 rules) and scanopy_discover (3 rules) loaded.
scanopy-retag.timer (15 min) and scanopy-discover.timer (minute 02/17/32/47) active; both services exit 0 and write their scanopy_retag_* / scanopy_discover_* textfile metrics.
With one Docker bridge subnet untagged the next run tagged it; 234 of 234 DockerBridge subnets carry the docker-bridge tag.

A due host was started exactly once through POST /api/v1/discovery/start-session and an immediate second run skipped it; the HTTP 409 (already running) path was exercised against a scan still in progress.

Not run: ansible is not installed on the operator machine or the Builder, and the controller-local secret files the role expects are not present. A later converge should be a no-op for these files, which were verified identical to the rendered output.

notes: The two jobs were first installed by hand on 2026-10-12, then codified in #316 and released in #324; this receipt records syncing the live VM to main.
Both jobs read the Scanopy API key from /etc/scanopy-retag/api-key (root 0600). The live key is an Admin-level key by operator choice; a Member-level key is preferred.

Scanopy-side runtime settings (docker-bridge tag, topology hidden tag, DockerSocket credential assignments, per-daemon Scheduled discoveries) live in the Scanopy database and are documented in the runbook, not in git.
ScanopyDiscoveryOverdue is expected to fire once, about an hour after the rules loaded, for hosts last scanned on 2026-10-08, and to clear after their first nightly slot.
